name: When is the best time of year to paint a house exterior in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to paint a house exterior in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to paint a house exterior in the DFW area is typically spring or fall. These seasons offer moderate temperatures and lower humidity, which are crucial for proper paint application and curing. Painting during extreme heat or cold can affect paint adhesion and longevity. Avoiding the peak summer heat and rainy winter days ensures the best conditions for a successful and durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spring or fall are best in DFW due to moderate temperatures and lower humidity, which aid paint application and curing. Avoid extreme heat or cold.
